positive_snippets: Had a pleasant stay at Sun View International. Comfortable rooms, good service, and a peaceful environment. Would recommend for a relaxing getaway.

The rooms are spacious, clean, and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. The décor is modern yet cozy, with all necessary amenities such as high-speed internet, a flat-screen TV, a minibar, and a comfortable work desk. The beds are particularly comfortable, ensuring a good night's sleep.

Recently, I stayed at Sun View International Hotel and I can vouch to say that this has been my best experience in Delhi. The rooms and washrooms r awesome, neat abd clean. The staff r polite, cooperative and very courteous. It was just like a home to me. Besides, the breakfast and food served were healthy and delicious. In short, it is simply SUPERB. Pls.dnt think twice to book the hotel.
negative_snippets: Nice hotel to stay for short time to take rest if you go for a long ride food quality was also good and tasty no other big market available no other visits point but hotel was good

Decent hotel, if you are looking for stay in the heart of city, karbagh, complimentary breakfast is pathetic. Conference hall available. Rooms are old, but bathrooms are renovated and clean. Hot water available in morning only. Great value for money room
